name: spec-commerce
description: Merchant-installed layer that turns building specifications into verified, purchasable bills of materials, with WebMCP tools on the merchant origin.

scripts.deploy:static: pnpm assemble && wrangler pages deploy dist/static --project-name stationbell-static --branch main --commit-dirty=true
scripts.deploy:site: pnpm assemble && test -f dist/site/index.html && wrangler pages deploy dist/site --project-name spec-commerce --branch main --commit-dirty=true
scripts.ship:preview: SC_STATIC_ORIGIN=https://preview.stationbell-static.pages.dev pnpm assemble && wrangler pages deploy dist/static --project-name stationbell-static --branch preview --commit-dirty=true && wrangler pages deploy dist/site --project-name spec-commerce --branch preview --commit-dirty=true
